title: Hays County grass ID candidate staging queue
provenance: iNaturalist /observations/species_counts, research grade, county Hays; compared to 112 source records and their stored synonyms
selection_rules: Only taxa with research-grade iNaturalist observations inside Hays County; do not infer nativity/wild establishment or trust iNaturalist determinations uncritically
exclusion_rules: Exclude non-Hays observations from active phase (preserved in original full 12-county audit); do not add established aliases as new cards
editorial_guardrails: Preserve existing 112, photos, arrows, diagrams and morphology during review.
Do not create species.json records, publish cards, or trigger main-branch auto-sync until manual source verification.
Review each taxon name against Flora of North Central Texas / Flora of North America, along with current accepted names, before proposing incorporation.
Source IDs and plant associations require image/location check. iNaturalist research-grade alone is insufficient.
Keep introduced grasses eligible for field ID, but label them; cultivated ornamental/lawn observations require establishment review.
County focus is for encounter/ID coverage. BONAP NAPA nativity certification is a later independent gate.
Archive regional candidate list; never delete the historical full audit.
